interpretation_limits: mFAS size is not endpoint paired N.
A reported marginal mean difference is not automatically a paired mean change.
A post-hoc matched different-disease comparison does not establish causal efficacy.
Equal-sized feasibility/completion or mFAS/safety sets need not contain the same people.
Unrecovered abstract content is not a negative treatment result or evidence of nonexistence.
A family/genotype match inferred from authorship and sibling description is not verified patient linkage.
